notes: P3 PLANNING ROUND (feat/p3-s1-outcome-label-seam, commit a3dbb03c) -- reconnaissance and slice plan, no code yet. The ticket was a blank placeholder (status planning, subtasks [], no prd.md, both jsonl files holding only the example line), so this round produced prd.md with thirty-odd file:line findings, a rewritten framing, four slices, the red lines, the refusals and four open rulings. THE LOAD-BEARING FINDING: the parent ticket lists four things and THREE OF THEM ALREADY EXIST -- offline quality vs online reward is already distinguished in storage (evaluator_samples.label_source is declared as "evaluator" | "engagement" | "human_review", evaluator_config.py:347, with engagement as its own JSONB column), the online reward is already collected for real (creator_note_stats in db/creator_stats.py:70-91 carries views/likes/comments/collects/shares and its own engagement_rate, fed by a 6225-line services/creator_stats/ subsystem with a 1576-line CDP client), LearningSignal -> ModelRevision already has a full lifecycle, and the two personalization stacks ALREADY SHARE A READ SEAM (memory/creator_agent_observations.py:111 implements the CreatorContentObservationSource protocol declared in creator_agent/observations.py:16, consumed by creator_agent/advisor.py:177). Nothing needs to be built. WHAT IS ACTUALLY MISSING IS TWO CONNECTIONS, and both are proven, not inferred: (1) THE WEAK-LABEL FEED PATH DOES NOT EXIST. The only regular writer of evaluator_samples.engagement is agents/analyst.py:271-280, and its dict comprehension filters five keys (views/likes/collects/comments/shares) that publisher.py NEVER writes -- grep for those literals in publisher.py returns ZERO hits, and all twelve places that assign into publish_result carry error/error_type/recovery/result_known/note/publish_id metadata only. The gate is therefore always false. CORRECTED ON S1 DAY 1 (see prd.md section 9): the auto edge was removed, but analyst is NOT unreachable -- builder.py:187 continues 'It can be reached by resuming the workflow with phase=analyzing', state/modes.py:170/188 both map ANALYZING -> analyst, and api/routes/_wf_application.py:1818 is a complete manual trigger endpoint (assert_thread_owned + a has_analytics idempotence gate + Command(goto=["analyst"])). So the break is NOT 'nobody runs it', it is 'running it still cannot work': publish_result carries none of the five keys, and the manual path reads the same publish-time dict. Corroboration: label_source="engagement" appears ZERO times in backend/. (2) THE REAL METRICS NEVER REACH THE LEARNER. analytics.py contains ZERO references to evaluator_config / backfill_engagement / evaluator_samples / insert_sample, and the linker's product (link_status="linked", written only at analytics.py:894 and :908) is a REQUEST-TIME PROJECTION that is never persisted. evaluator_samples has no platform_post_id column while backfill_engagement(thread_id, ...) keys on thread_id -- so even a willing caller has no key to join on. CONSEQUENCE (assertable): count_labeled_since counts engagement IS NOT NULL, so it is identically 0, which is below MIN_EVOLVE_SAMPLES = 10 (evaluator_config.py:896), so maybe_evolve never leaves the below-threshold branch (evaluator_config.py:976-977) and train_weights / PromptEpoch never advance. THE WHOLE LOOP IS STRUCTURALLY COMPLETE, FULLY TESTED AND GREEN, AND HAS NEVER RUN ONCE -- the purest member of the 'declaration is not execution' family: evaluator_config.py's module docstring promises 'eventually trained from real engagement feedback', analyst.py:263 promises a 'weak label for grader finetuning', publisher.py:351 promises an explicit id match -- three declarations, zero data points. REFRAMING (same shape as P2c's 'not a missing Planner, a missing plan object'): P3 is not missing an Outcome Learning loop, it is missing the two wires that were designed into it. Consequence for slicing: no new module, no new Agent, no cross-module refactor -- each slice only has to make one existing wire actually carry current. SLICES: S1 make the situation visible and stop the bleeding (turn 'the loop never started' into a gate that goes red, and deal with analyst.py's always-empty back-fill, today's biggest source of misinformation). S2 lift the linker out of request-time projection into a reusable form and give evaluator_samples a nullable platform_post_id. S3 close the wire: after creator-stats/sync, back-fill real metrics into evaluator_samples.engagement with label_source="engagement", the first moment maybe_evolve is reachable. S4 the contract and gate condition document (docs/outcome-learning.md). S1's gate must distinguish 'never started' from 'ran and produced zero' -- those two are identical on all real data today (the same family as P2c-S5's 'a claim whose value is zero has no built-in control'), so it has to point at somewhere the thing DOES exist. OPEN RULINGS (all four carry the measured fact that decides them): (1) the parent's 'unify the two personalization stacks into a Memory Fabric' -- the READ side is already unified and no call site today reads both sides, so the write side is NOT consolidated; (2) merging decision-side LearningSignal (feedback-driven, pending_creator_review = human-gated) with engagement weak labels (automatic) would change the human gate's semantics, so NOT merged until a conflicting-conclusion instance exists; (3) whether creator_note_stats should re-drive sample recomputation -- deferred until S3 shows the re-back-fill cost (the table is an upsert and notes keep accruing); (4) MOST IMPORTANT -- what happens to the analyst node now that it is unreachable, since all three of its jobs (content_history metrics, weak-label back-fill, insights) silently stop happening when it does not run, while S1 must answer whether to restore its trigger or hand its duties to capability that already exists elsewhere. ANCHOR DISCIPLINE: every file:line claim in prd.md was programmatically re-checked after writing (51 anchors, each asserting an expected token on the cited line); the first pass caught 10 anchors that had drifted by 1-5 lines, all corrected before commit, and the document's stated counts (6225 / 1576 / 0 / 0 / 0) are re-derived by the same checker rather than copied.
